text: Claire and Theo are having a housewarming on Saturday 7 November 2026 from 4pm. New place is in Walthamstow, two streets from the canal.

Anil was made redundant last Thursday, along with most of his department. He's putting a brave face on it and keeps saying it's a chance to finally do something he enjoys, but he sounded flat on the phone and his wife is on maternity leave, so money will be tight. I should check in with him early next week.
Angela and Michael got engaged in Lisbon over the weekend! Need to send them a card and something fizzy.
Rosa's dad passed away on Sunday morning. The funeral is on 3 November 2026 at 11am at St Mary's. I'm going with Yuki.

Dinner at Olivia's on Friday at 7.30. It's her, her flatmate Yasmin, and a couple of people from her climbing group I haven't met. She said not to bring anything, but she loves dark chocolate, so I'll take some anyway. Remember she's moved, it's the new place off Mill Road now, top bell.
Aleksander and Sofia's tenth wedding anniversary is on the 14th. They're keeping it low key, just a meal at the Italian place they went to on their first date.

Miriam told me over lunch that she and Karim have split up after six years. It was her decision, and she says it's been coming for a long time, but she's still finding it hard, especially since they share a dog. Her sister is staying with her for a bit, and she's moving into a rented flat on 1 December 2026.
Remind me to text Emre on Wednesday evening to see how the meeting with HR went.
Arjun is turning forty and his wife Mai is throwing a surprise party on 21 November 2026. Starts at 8pm sharp, everyone has to be there by quarter to. Don't mention it to him.
Milan's leaving drinks were cancelled because half the team is off sick. He said they'll try again in the new year.
Bought the train tickets for Reza and Eli's wedding in Edinburgh. Ceremony is 12 June 2027 at 2pm. I'm staying two nights at the Balmoral end of Princes Street.
Yasmin's grandmother died last week. She was very close to her; she basically raised Yasmin until she was ten. I must send flowers before the funeral on Tuesday.
Antoine mentioned he's been learning to make sourdough since lockdown and now bakes every weekend. Also obsessed with Formula 1.
Krisztina's engagement party is on the 12th at half 9 in the evening, upstairs at the Crown. Dress code is "cocktail", whatever that means.
Ran into Reggie at the shop. His dog Biscuit had to have an operation on her leg yesterday afternoon. She's home now but very sorry for herself.
Emily Walsh (Em to everyone) invited me to her thirtieth. It's a garden party on Sunday 30 May 2027, weather permitting.
Need to pick up the suit from the dry cleaners tomorrow morning before 10.
Eduardo and his partner Jess are celebrating five years together this Saturday. He's planning a weekend in the Cotswolds and asked me not to tell her.
Elena was let go from the agency on Monday. Twelve years there and they gave her one afternoon's notice. She's angry more than sad, I think. I should take her out for lunch next week.

Thomas asked if I could help with the speech for his brother Jakub's wedding. The wedding is 18 September 2027 and Thomas is the best man. He's terrified of public speaking and already has a draft that's mostly in-jokes from their uni days. We're meeting on Sunday afternoon at 3 to go through it, and I said I'd bring some examples of speeches that worked.
Mia's mum's funeral went ahead this morning. Lots of people turned up. Don't forget to message Mia on Friday, the second week is always worse.
Rebecca says her parents are renewing their vows in March 2027 for their fortieth anniversary. She's organising the whole thing and is already stressed about the venue.
Karim's flat-warming is next Friday at 7pm. He's vegan now, so I'll bring that cashew dip.
Anil had his first interview since the redundancy this morning. Need to ask him how it went tomorrow.
Claire's brother Milan is getting married again, this time in Crete on 5 August 2027. She's sort of the best woman. She's already planning a joint stag and hen weekend for some time in July.
Theo dropped a hint that Claire has wanted a proper record player for ages. Their anniversary is coming up in December.
Note to self: RSVP to Angela's dinner by Thursday.
Heard from Michael that Olivia and her boyfriend broke up a couple of weeks ago. She hasn't mentioned it, so I won't bring it up unless she does.
Sofia is hosting Diwali dinner at hers on Saturday 7 November. Aleksander is cooking, which apparently means we eat at ten.

Coffee with Rosa this afternoon. She's doing better than I expected after the funeral, but she said nights are the worst. Her uncle is coming to stay from Porto at the end of the month, which should help. I want to drop round some food on Sunday.
Miriam's work Christmas party is on Friday 11 December at 6pm, and she asked if I'd be her plus one.

Emre is waiting to hear whether his job is one of the ones being cut. The final decision comes on 2 November 2026. He has two kids and a mortgage, so he's understandably nervous. I should call him that evening, whatever happens.
Arjun and Mai have a cat called Pickle who apparently hates visitors. Good to know before the party.
Milan is allergic to shellfish. Keep that in mind for the dinner.
Yuki got engaged! Her boyfriend proposed on a hike in the Lake District last Sunday. Wedding probably next spring, maybe April 2027.
Reza's father has been made redundant after thirty years at the same firm. Reza's worried about him more than anything. Ask Reza how his dad is doing when I see him at the weekend.
Eli said they're going to do a small engagement dinner first, just close friends, on the 28th at 7. I'm invited.
Party at Antoine's tomorrow night was called off. His landlord is doing emergency repairs on the boiler.

Have to buy a gift for Krisztina and Jakub's wedding. They have a registry at John Lewis but she said honestly cash for the honeymoon fund would be best, since they're going to Japan for three weeks in October 2027. Her mum is apparently horrified by the idea of cash, so maybe something small from the list as well.
Reggie's wife Emily passed away two years ago today. He mentioned it quietly at the end of the call. I should give him a ring tonight.
Eduardo's leaving do from the bank is on Thursday 26 November at 5.30. He's retiring after twenty-eight years and seems genuinely happy about it.
Jess is nervous about meeting Eduardo's family at his mum's seventieth next Saturday lunchtime. She asked me what to wear. I told her not to overthink it.
Mai's brother Karim is getting divorced. She said he's not really talking to anyone. Maybe invite him for a pint sometime soon.

Thomas and Rebecca are celebrating their twentieth anniversary with a party at the cricket club. It's on Saturday 16 January 2027, from 7 until late. They specifically said no presents, but Rebecca mentioned she'd love a donation to the hospice instead.
Dentist appointment moved to Monday at 8.15.
Olivia is doing a dinner party for her birthday on the 3rd. She's into natural wine at the moment, so a bottle of something orange would go down well.

Called Elena back this evening. She's had two recruiters in touch already and sounds much brighter than she did on Monday. She has a second-round interview on Friday at 2pm with a children's charity in Bristol, which would mean moving, but she says she's ready for a change anyway. Her partner Reza is fully on board. Text her Friday evening to see how it went.
Jakub mentioned his grandfather's funeral is in Kraków on 9 November 2026. He's flying out on the 7th and back on the 11th. He asked if I could feed his rabbit, Pierogi, while he's away.
Angela's parents are throwing them an engagement party in Leeds at Easter. Michael's family are coming over from Dublin for it.
Theo is still really struggling after the breakup with Antoine. He's not eating properly and he called in sick twice this week. I need to check on him tomorrow.

Sofia mentioned that Aleksander's mum has been in hospital since Saturday with pneumonia. She's eighty-three and quite frail, so they're worried. They're cancelling the trip to Gdańsk they had planned for the end of the month and Aleksander is driving up to Newcastle on Thursday morning to be with her. I should offer to have the kids after school on Thursday and Friday.
Housewarming at Mia and Jakub's went really well. Need to send Mia the photos from Saturday.
Yasmin's cousin is getting married this weekend and she's doing the mehndi for everyone on Friday night. She does henna professionally on the side.
Arjun Singh from the old office got in touch. Apparently he and his wife have just celebrated twenty-five years married. I'd like to send them a card.
Picked up the cards for the week: one for Eli's engagement, one sympathy card for Rosa's family, and one for Claire's birthday. Post them all tomorrow morning.
Krisztina says Milan has started dating again after his divorce. He's happy, which is lovely to hear.

Michael has been invited to give a eulogy at his godfather's funeral on Wednesday at 10. He's never done anything like it and is dreading it. Remember to text Michael the night before to wish him luck.
Quiet one. Spent the evening sorting the spare room for when Mum visits.

Emily's engagement got called off last month, I found out today. She's moved back in with her parents for now and is applying for jobs in Manchester. I want to send her something to cheer her up, maybe that candle she likes.

Reza and Eli have booked a venue for the wedding: a barn near Hexham, 12 June 2027, ceremony at 2, reception from 5. Save-the-dates are going out after Christmas. Eli asked if I'd do a reading, which I'm honoured by. I should think about which poem this weekend.
